title: 第560章 虚空殿第559章 东天秘籍
slug: 昆仑山修仙下山后我无敌了
content_zh:
“走吧！”
云峰也是一样，直接召唤出了飞剑，和女儿踩着飞剑上了天空。
一群人御剑飞行离开了。
很快的功夫，五个人就飞出了城镇，下面都是一望无际的海洋。
海水的雾气很重，海面上很冷，云峰还看到了不远处有一股黑色的飓风。
“那是黑龙卷，大家注意避开一点，因为就算是元婴期修士被黑龙卷碰到也会陨落的。”
看到远处海面上的黑龙卷后，周姓修士说道，他手指一动，改变了飞剑的飞行方向，尽量绕着黑龙卷的方向走。
云峰和其余的人也点了点头，那远处的黑龙卷看起来声势浩大，吓人的很，他们也不敢接近，都改变了飞剑的方向。
飞驰了大概半个时辰的功夫，就到了地点。云峰惊讶地看到，前方的天空上漂浮着一个巨大的白光，白光看起来像是一个传送门的样子。
“那就是虚空殿的传送门了，秘境就是在里面开启的，我们进去吧。”
周姓修士笑嘻嘻地说道，然后脚踩着飞剑进入了那白光传送门里消失掉了。然后云峰和女儿、刘姓修士和李姓修士也纷纷如此，都进入到了传送门里。
在进入天空上大传送门的一瞬间，云峰感觉眼前一黑，然后就发现自己出现在了一个新奇的地方。
这个地方就和西游记的天庭一样，他看到了很多手持长矛，穿着盔甲的士兵。
更加恐怖的是，云峰没办法看穿这些侍卫的境界。而看不穿对方的境界只有一个可能性，就是对方的境界比他高很多，起码也是金丹期以上的修为了。
但是这些站岗的侍卫都是金丹期以上，这到底是什么地方，有多恐怖。
“厉道友，我和你解释一下，这里是虚空殿，是星宫的地盘。星宫是我们灵界六大势力之一，知道吗？这次东天秘境也是星宫负责召开的。这些侍卫都是星宫的弟子，境界我也不清楚，不过肯定不是我们能招惹的。”
看到云峰一脸懵，周姓修士笑嘻嘻地解释道。
“哦，原来是这样，星宫？嗯，我以前似乎听师傅说过。”
云峰点了点头，以前在蓝星的时候，他就听师傅陈北玄说过星宫，据说是灵界非常厉害的存在，如今看来的确如此。
“走吧，就在前面。”

接下来周姓修士在前带路，很快的功夫，云峰就看到了一个辉煌无比的大殿。大殿门口有两座金光闪闪的狮子，有青石台阶，大殿明显就是开启秘境的地方了。
跟着周姓修士进入到了大殿，云峰看到了很多很多桌子椅子，每个椅子都坐着人。
男男女女，老老少少，基本上都是修仙者，境界高深的修仙者，金丹期修士。
其中金丹期修士大都是老头，他们的身边或多或少都有一个炼气期的女子。女子似乎是陪酒女郎一样，给老者倒酒，而且老者的手还不安分地在炼气期女性身上摸来摸去。
“这些炼气期女子都是星宫的仆人，她们的任务就是来陪这些实力强悍、来参加秘境的男人喝酒睡觉，你只要给她们一点灵石就行。”
周姓修士解释道。
“哦，这就是修仙版的商k吗？”
云峰一愣，看着那些依偎在老怪物身上的炼气期女修，哭笑不得。
content_en:
"Let's go!"
Yunfeng did the same. He directly summoned the flying sword, and he and his daughter stepped on the flying sword into the sky.
A group of people flew away with their swords.
In a short time, the five people flew out of the town, with the endless ocean below them.
The fog in the sea was heavy and the sea was very cold. Yunfeng also saw a black hurricane not far away.
"That's a black tornado. Everyone, be careful to avoid it, because even a Nascent Soul monk will fall if he is touched by a black tornado."
After seeing the black tornado on the sea in the distance, the monk surnamed Zhou said. With a move of his finger, he changed the flight direction of the flying sword and tried to go around the direction of the black tornado.
Yunfeng and the others also nodded. The black tornado in the distance looked huge and scary. They did not dare to approach it and they all changed the direction of the flying sword.
After flying for about half an hour, we arrived at the location. Yunfeng was surprised to see a huge white light floating in the sky in front of him. The white light looked like a portal.
"That is the portal of the Void Palace. The secret realm is opened inside. Let's go in."
The monk surnamed Zhou said with a smile, then stepped on the flying sword and entered the white light portal and disappeared. Then Yunfeng, his daughter, monks surnamed Liu and monks surnamed Li also followed suit and entered the portal.
The moment he entered the big portal in the sky, Yunfeng felt his eyes go dark, and then he found himself in a strange place.
This place was just like the Heavenly Court in Journey to the West. He saw many soldiers holding spears and wearing armor.
What's even more terrifying is that Yunfeng can't see through the realm of these guards. There is only one possibility for not being able to see through the other party's realm, that is, the other party's realm is much higher than his, at least at the Golden Core stage or above.
But these guards on guard are all at the Golden Core stage or above. What kind of place is this and how terrifying it is.
"Fellow Daoist Li, let me explain to you that this is the Void Palace, the territory of the Star Palace. The Star Palace is one of the six major forces in our spiritual world, do you know? The Eastern Sky Secret Realm is also held by the Star Palace this time. These guards are all disciples of the Star Palace. I don't know their realms, but they are definitely not something we can provoke."
Seeing Yunfeng's confused face, the monk surnamed Zhou explained with a smile.
"Oh, so that's it, Xing Gong? Well, I seem to have heard the master say it before."
Yunfeng nodded. When he was at Blue Star, he had heard his master Chen Beixuan talk about Star Palace, which was said to be a very powerful existence in the spiritual world. Now it seems that it is indeed the case.
"Let's go, right in front."
Next, the monk surnamed Zhou led the way. Soon, Yunfeng saw a magnificent hall. There are two gleaming golden lions and bluestone steps at the entrance of the main hall. The main hall is obviously the place where the secret realm is opened.
Following the monk surnamed Zhou into the main hall, Yunfeng saw many tables and chairs, each with people sitting on them.
Men and women, old and young, are basically immortal cultivators, advanced immortal cultivators, and golden elixir stage monks.
Among them, most of the golden elixir stage monks are old men, and there is more or less a woman in the Qi refining stage beside them. The woman seemed to be a bartender, pouring wine for the old man, and the old man's hands restlessly touched the body of the woman in the Qi refining period.
"These women in the Qi Refining Period are servants of the Star Palace. Their mission is to drink and sleep with these powerful men who come to participate in the secret realm. You only need to give them some spiritual stones."
The monk surnamed Zhou explained.
"Oh, is this the immortal version of Shang K?"
Yunfeng was stunned, looking at the female cultivators in the Qi refining stage clinging to the old monster, dumbfounded.
